data.body:
[P2] Preserve the observed order of retry attempts

This branch treats lists as unordered inventories, but `replay.retry.attempts` is order-sensitive: the standard replay validator requires the first attempt to fail and the last to succeed. If context observations retain `[SUCCEEDED, FAILED]` and collection returns those same records reordered as `[FAILED, SUCCEEDED]`, retention reports no change and the case can pass. Retirement auditing does not check this replay field either. Preserve the known relative order for this path while allowing additional observations, and add a coordinator regression using the standard replay validator.
